title: Elvarika's Redesign: Bundle Drops From 2.4MB to 0.65MB | vitalii.no
description:
Elvarika's interface had grown piecemeal across features for years — grammar pages, collection stubs, a classic analysis view, fake cost-analytics widgets, an old billing UI, an impersonation banner — until the app was shipping a 2.4 MB main bundle, and the first screen waited up to 3 seconds on a health check before it would even draw itself.

The whole frontend was rebuilt around a new design system: semantic color tokens derived from the logo palette in light and dark, self-hosted fonts, and a documented UI kit with a sidebar shell on desktop and a tab bar on phones. A typed data layer replaced ad-hoc fetch calls across admin, courses, credits, jobs, library, review and team screens, and a compile-time-checked setup now backs the English, Ukrainian and Norwegian interface. Fifteen unused dependencies and every dead screen — the old grammar and collections stubs, the classic analysis page, the fake cost analytics, the old billing UI, the impersonation banner — were deleted, and the first render no longer blocks on a health check.

The main JavaScript bundle dropped from 2.4 MB to 0.65 MB, and visitors no longer wait on a blank screen before the app appears.
